news.headline: French newspapers appeal to antitrust regulator over Google's AI summaries
news.summary: French newspapers have asked the country’s antitrust watchdog to take action over Google’s new AI-generated summaries – which appear at the top of search results – saying they are depriving news publishers of web traffic.
